1.visual: A large hollow circle with a small filled circle (dot) at its center, representing a radio button in its selected/active state. The outer ring is thick and the inner dot is clearly centered.
1.usage: Radio button selected state in a single-choice question group, option selector in settings panels, plan/tier selection UI, gender or preference form fields.

2.visual: A rounded rectangle (pill-shaped outer border) containing three horizontal dots evenly spaced in a row, resembling a text input field with placeholder dots. The corners are fully rounded giving it a capsule shape.
2.usage: Password input field indicator, masked or hidden text field, PIN entry input, placeholder representation for a text input in a form layout.

3.visual: A square with rounded corners containing a bold checkmark in the lower-left-to-upper-right direction, representing a checked checkbox. The checkmark stroke is thick and clearly visible inside the square.
3.usage: Checkbox in its checked/selected state, task completion toggle, agreement to terms of service, multi-select list item that has been chosen.

4.visual: A text cursor (I-beam) symbol with two horizontal bars — one at the top and one at the bottom — flanked by curved bracket-like serifs on the left and right sides, indicating an active text input field. The overall shape resembles a capital letter I with wide serifs.
4.usage: Active or focused text input field, cursor placement indicator in a form field, inline text editing mode, search input focus state.

5.visual: A rounded rectangle (toggle switch outline) with a circle positioned on the left side inside it, indicating an off/disabled toggle state. The circle sits flush to the left end of the pill-shaped track.
5.usage: Toggle switch in the off/disabled position, feature flag disabled state, notification preference turned off, dark mode switcher in the inactive state.

6.visual: A rounded rectangle (toggle switch outline) with a circle positioned on the right side inside it, indicating an on/enabled toggle state. The circle sits flush to the right end of the pill-shaped track, mirroring icon 5 but flipped.
6.usage: Toggle switch in the on/enabled position, feature flag enabled state, notification preference turned on, settings option that is currently active.
